description: This file declares classes and methods related to managing video recording sources within a WebRTC streaming context, including a RecordingManager class that handles adding, removing, starting, and stopping video sources and recorders.

classes.name: Source
classes.description: Represents a video source with specified dimensions and a video track interface.

classes.name: RecordingManager
classes.description: Manages video recording sources, including adding, removing, starting, stopping, and waiting for sources.

methods.name: AddSource
methods.description: Adds a new video source with specified dimensions, video track, and label.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Removes a video source identified by its label.

methods.name: WaitForSources
methods.description: Blocks until the specified number of sources are available.

methods.name: StartSingleRecorder
methods.description: Initializes and starts a recorder for a specific source label.
